worked.problem: A tangent at A forms an angle of 32° with chord AB. C lies on the major arc AB. Find ∠ACB.
actions: Mark the 32° angle between the tangent ray at A and chord AB.
Join C to A and B. Angle ACB subtends chord AB on the alternate side of the tangent.
By the tangent–chord theorem, the angle in the alternate segment equals the tangent–chord angle.
Thus ∠ACB has the same measure as the marked angle at A: 32°.
Answer: ∠ACB = 32°. Its intercepted minor arc AB has centre angle 64°.
worked.check: Answer: ∠ACB = 32°. Its intercepted minor arc AB has centre angle 64°.
